title: Social Order and Disorder as Coherence Phenomena
description:
Description
This paper analyzes social stability as a function of constraint coherence across norms, enforcement, and outcomes. It demonstrates how disorder emerges when constraint fragmentation increases corrective load and rule proliferation, independent of cultural interpretation or subjective belief.
